6: # OpenAI Docs MCP Skill
7: 
8: ## Overview
9: 
10: Use the OpenAI developer documentation MCP server from the shell to search and fetch authoritative docs. Always do this for OpenAI platform work instead of relying on memory or non-official sources.
11: 
12: ## Core rules
13: 
14: - Always use this skill for OpenAI API/SDK/Apps/Codex questions or when precise, current docs are required.
15: - Query the MCP server via the CLI wrapper in `scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh` (do not rely on Codex MCP tools).
16: - Use `search` or `list` to find the best doc page, then `fetch` the page (or anchor) for exact text.
17: - Surface the doc URL you used in your response so sources are clear.
18: 
19: ## Quick start
20: 
21: ```bash
22: scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh search "Responses API" 5
23: scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh fetch https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/migrate-to-responses
24: ```
25: 
26: ## Workflow
27: 
28: 1. Discover: `search` with a focused query. If unsure, use `list` to browse.
29: 2. Read: `fetch` the most relevant URL (optionally add an anchor).
30: 3. Apply: summarize and/or quote relevant sections; include the URL.
31: 
32: ## Script reference
33: 
34: The CLI wrapper is at `scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh` and uses `curl` + `jq` against `https://developers.openai.com/mcp`.
35: 
36: Subcommands:
37: - `init`: initialize and inspect server capabilities.
38: - `tools`: list available tools on the MCP server.
39: - `search <query> [limit] [cursor]`: return JSON hits from the docs index.
40: - `list [limit] [cursor]`: browse docs index.
41: - `fetch <url> [anchor]`: return markdown for a doc page or section.
42: - `endpoints`: list OpenAPI endpoints.
43: - `openapi <endpoint-url> [lang1,lang2] [code-only]`: fetch OpenAPI schema or code samples.
44: 
45: Environment:
46: - `MCP_URL`: override the default MCP endpoint.", "scripts/openai-docs-mcp.sh": "1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: set -euo pipefail
3: 
4: MCP_URL="${MCP_URL:-https://developers.openai.com/mcp}"
5: 
6: usage() {
7:   cat <<'EOF'
8: OpenAI Docs MCP (CLI)
9: 
10: Usage:
11:   openai-docs-mcp.sh init
12:   openai-docs-mcp.sh tools
13:   openai-docs-mcp.sh search <query> [limit] [cursor]
14:   openai-docs-mcp.sh list [limit] [cursor]
15:   openai-docs-mcp.sh fetch <url> [anchor]
16:   openai-docs-mcp.sh endpoints
17:   openai-docs-mcp.sh openapi <endpoint-url> [lang1,lang2] [code-only]
18: 
19: Environment:
20:   MCP_URL  Override the MCP endpoint (default: https://developers.openai.com/mcp)
21: EOF
22: }
23: 
24: require_cmd() {
25:   command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
26:     echo "Missing required command: $1" >&2
27:     exit 1
28:   }
29: }
30: 
31: mcp_request() {
32:   local payload="$1"
33:   curl -s -N \
34:     -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
35:     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
36:     -X POST "$MCP_URL" \
37:     -d "$payload" \
38:     | sed -n 's/^data: //p' \
39:     | tail -n 1
40: }
41: 
42: mcp_call() {
43:   local method="$1"
44:   local params="${2:-null}"
45:   local payload
46:   if [[ "$params" == "null" ]]; then
47:     payload=$(jq -n --arg method "$method" '{jsonrpc:"2.0",id:1,method:$method}')
48:   else
49:     payload=$(jq -n --arg method "$method" --argjson params "$params" '{jsonrpc:"2.0",id:1,method:$method,params:$params}')
50:   fi
51:   mcp_request "$payload"
52: }
53: 
54: mcp_tool_call() {
55:   local name="$1"
56:   local args_json="$2"
57:   local payload
58:   payload=$(jq -n --arg name "$name" --argjson args "$args_json" '{jsonrpc:"2.0",id:1,method:"tools/call",params:{name:$name,arguments:$args}}')
59:   mcp_request "$payload"
60: }
61: 
62: ensure_ok() {
63:   local resp="$1"
64:   if echo "$resp" | jq -e '.error' >/dev/null; then
65:     echo "$resp" | jq -r '.error' >&2
66:     exit 1
67:   fi
68: }
69: 
70: is_int() {
71:   [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
72: }
73: 
74: require_cmd curl
75: require_cmd jq
76: 
77: if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then
78:   usage
79:   exit 1
80: fi
81: 
82: cmd="$1"
83: shift
84: 
85: case "$cmd" in
86:   init)
87:     resp="$(mcp_call "initialize" "$(jq -n '{protocolVersion:"2025-03-26",capabilities:{},clientInfo:{name:"openai-docs-mcp-cli",version:"1.0.0"}}')")"
88:     ensure_ok "$resp"
89:     echo "$resp" | jq
90:     ;;
91:   tools)
92:     resp="$(mcp_call "tools/list")"
93:     ensure_ok "$resp"
94:     echo "$resp" | jq
95:     ;;
96:   search)
97:     query="${1:-}"
98:     limit="${2:-}"
99:     cursor="${3:-}"
100:     if [[ -z "$query" ]]; then
101:       usage
102:       exit 1
103:     fi
104:     if [[ -n "$limit" ]] && ! is_int "$limit"; then
105:       echo "limit must be an integer" >&2
106:       exit 1
107:     fi
108:     args="$(jq -n --arg query "$query" --arg limit "${limit:-}" --arg cursor "${cursor:-}" \
109:       '{query:$query}
110:        + (if ($limit | length) > 0 then {limit: ($limit|tonumber)} else {} end)
111:        + (if ($cursor | length) > 0 then {cursor: $cursor} else {} end)')"
112:     resp="$(mcp_tool_call "search_openai_docs" "$args")"
113:     ensure_ok "$resp"
114:     echo "$resp" | jq -r '.result.content[0].text | fromjson'
115:     ;;
116:   list)
117:     limit="${1:-}"
118:     cursor="${2:-}"
119:     if [[ -n "$limit" ]] && ! is_int "$limit"; then
120:       echo "limit must be an integer" >&2
121:       exit 1
122:     fi
123:     args="$(jq -n --arg limit "${limit:-}" --arg cursor "${cursor:-}" \
124:       '(if ($limit | length) > 0 then {limit: ($limit|tonumber)} else {} end)
125:        + (if ($cursor | length) > 0 then {cursor: $cursor} else {} end)')"
126:     resp="$(mcp_tool_call "list_openai_docs" "$args")"
127:     ensure_ok "$resp"
128:     echo "$resp" | jq -r '.result.content[0].text | fromjson'
129:     ;;
130:   fetch)
131:     url="${1:-}"
132:     anchor="${2:-}"
133:     if [[ -z "$url" ]]; then
134:       usage
135:       exit 1
136:     fi
137:     args="$(jq -n --arg url "$url" --arg anchor "${anchor:-}" \
138:       '{url:$url} + (if ($anchor | length) > 0 then {anchor: $anchor} else {} end)')"
139:     resp="$(mcp_tool_call "fetch_openai_doc" "$args")"
140:     ensure_ok "$resp"
141:     echo "$resp" | jq -r '.result.content[0].text'
142:     ;;
143:   endpoints)
144:     resp="$(mcp_tool_call "list_api_endpoints" "$(jq -n '{}')")"
145:     ensure_ok "$resp"
146:     echo "$resp" | jq -r '.result.content[0].text | fromjson'
147:     ;;
148:   openapi)
149:     url="${1:-}"
150:     langs="${2:-}"
151:     code_only="${3:-}"
152:     if [[ -z "$url" ]]; then
153:       usage
154:       exit 1
155:     fi
156:     lang_json="[]"
157:     if [[ -n "$langs" ]]; then
158:       lang_json="$(printf '%s\n' "$langs" | tr ',' '\n' | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length>0))')"
159:     fi
160:     code_only_flag="false"
161:     if [[ "${code_only:-}" == "code-only" || "${code_only:-}" == "true" ]]; then
162:       code_only_flag="true"
163:     fi
164:     args="$(jq -n --arg url "$url" --argjson languages "$lang_json" --argjson codeOnly "$code_only_flag" \
165:       '{url:$url}
166:        + (if ($languages | length) > 0 then {languages: $languages} else {} end)
167:        + (if $codeOnly == true then {codeExamplesOnly: true} else {} end)')"
168:     resp="$(mcp_tool_call "get_openapi_spec" "$args")"
169:     ensure_ok "$resp"
170:     echo "$resp" | jq -r '.result.content[0].text | fromjson'
171:     ;;
172:   *)
173:     usage
174:     exit 1
175:     ;;
176: esac"}}
